purpose: deterministically characterize the published D-LUT trajectory under existing project explicit-operator gates
epistemic_status: post-exploratory deterministic characterization, not blind confirmatory evidence
exploratory_disclosure: before this contract was written, a read-only parser inspection observed out-of-range nodes and negative tetrahedral determinants; gates below are inherited from existing project contracts and were not selected to fit the observed values

audit.cube_axis_order: standard .cube red-fastest rows parsed from source B-G-R loop into project R-G-B axes
renderers: published-compatible trilinear analytic Jacobian sampled at a frozen 3x3x3 subgrid per cell

allowed_actions: parse and hash the fixed published LUT files
compute deterministic range, identity, smoothness and Jacobian diagnostics
forbidden_actions: train or rerun the score network
apply the LUTs to project photographs before structural survival
clip, project, smooth, regularize or refit the published LUTs
change Langevin step, epsilon, sample count or random seed
treat the style image or mapping as film-stock evidence
call this audit preregistered confirmatory evidence

branches.no_nonidentity_survivor: close the published D-LUT trajectory before image rendering; retain palette-matching and stochastic-fold evidence only
branches.one_or_more_survivors: freeze the earliest and strongest structurally valid steps for a separate A0 real-image severe/style contract
branches.asset_or_parser_failure: close as non-reproducible without repairing or replacing source artifacts

claim_ceiling: post-exploratory deterministic structural characterization of one official D-LUT style trajectory; never film-stock, preference, calibration, universal safety or unpaired-operator identification evidence
